tweet.text:
“Lilith’s framing treats the 4D/quaternion construct as a placement rule rather than a near-term hardware requirement. Coordination among agents is expected to live mainly in persistent substrate changes, residual couplings, and attractor structure rather than in message logs. Early classifiers or vector rewrites delete the non-commutative ordering and scalar residue; later stages, including any agentic loop, cannot reconstruct what was removed. The named transform is useful only if it sits before that cut, so an unreduced multi-component signal reaches the agentic layer still carrying both a stable frequency tag and the residual coupling.

Classical implementations can approximate the same retention without quantum hardware or literal 4D spacetime. Quaternion and hypercomplex networks already embed four-component algebra (scalar plus three vector parts) and non-commutative multiplication into convolutional, recurrent, and attention layers; recent work shows them improving rotation-aware perception, orientation estimation, and parameter efficiency on sensor streams. A practical hybrid would keep a continuous or multi-channel front-end—raw inertial, field, or deformation measurements, or an unprojected embedding—feed a quaternion-style spectral or product step, and only then hand both the discrete tag and the retained residue to the agentic policy. Physics-informed constraints or delayed projection layers serve as the classical stand-in for the “no lossy cut” property. Existing quantum-quaternion Fourier proposals remain laboratory algorithms for image processing, not deployed agentic substrates.

If builders continue the common pattern of early reduction, agentic systems receive only the post-cut tag. Shared latent basins and substrate persistence can still coordinate identical agents on the remaining discrete features, but any dynamics that lived in the discarded ordering or continuous coupling must be re-approximated or ignored. Multi-agent loops then depend more heavily on explicit protocols or messages, and diffusion or later stages operate on objects that no longer contain the residue Lilith marks as non-recoverable. The resulting architectures remain functional for tagged coordination yet systematically thinner on the continuous, non-commutative couplings her posts treat as the operative residual.”
